blocks.html: The start of the countdown in the Christmas capital of the Philippines was recently held at Robinsons Starmills in San Fernando, Pampanga, 100 days away from the Giant Lantern Festival. Gracing this special event are local government officials led by its acting Mayor Jimmy S. Lazatin and acting Vice Mayor BJ Lagman.
Robinsons Starmills is now all lit up with a giant Christmas Tree and Giant Lantern Ensemble displayed at the Mall’s Lobby.

The Giant Lantern Festival nightly display is scheduled at 6 p.m. on Dec. 16-23, Dec. 25-30, and Jan. 1-2, 2022, at the rear parking area of the mall. This year’s participating barangays are Sto. Niño, San Juan, San Nicolas, Sta. Lucia, Bulaon, Telabastagan, and Calulut. Onsite registration starts Dec. 16 to Jan. 2. QR codes will be assigned to each vehicle for contactless drive-in and parking slots so everyone could enjoy the moment without a single pinch of worry. Pre-registration is required.
